references.text: The same expression 'a land flowing with milk and honey' is used for the promised land that God gave to Israel's forefathers.
Moses asks God to bless his people Israel, similar to the blessing prayer in Deuteronomy 26:15.
Solomon asks God to hear from heaven, his dwelling place, and bless his people Israel.
Solomon asks God to hear in heaven, his dwelling place, using the same expression as 'your holy dwelling, from heaven'.
The psalmist asks God to look down from heaven and visit his people, similar to the expression 'look down from your holy dwelling'.
Isaiah uses the same expression 'look down from heaven and gaze down from your holy and glorious dwelling'.
The Lord roars from on high and lets his voice sound from his holy dwelling.
Zechariah mentions that the Lord awakens from his holy dwelling.
God's oath to Abraham to bless him and his descendants, as referred to by 'as you swore to our fathers'.
God confirms his oath to Isaac to give him and his descendants the land.
